<var>
$DPS$ = Damage / Swingrate
$AFDPS$ = Aftershock Damage / Swingrate
$FDPS$ = Frozen Damage / Swingrate
$FDMG$ = {{#expr:Damage * 2 round 0}}
$ADMG$ = {{#expr:ceil(Damage * 0.4)}}
$DPS2$ = $DPS$ + $AFDPS$
$FDPS2$ = $FDPS$ + $AFDPS$
$MDPS$ = ($DPS$) * Max Hits
$MDPS2$ = ($FDPS2$) * Max Hits
$COST$ = 950; 400; 1650; 3200; 8250; 16000
$CE$ = Total Cost / DPS
$MCE$ = Total Cost / Max DPS
$FREF$ = <ref>Frozen damage is dealt when hitting enemies that are already frozen or chilled. Frozen damage is double the regular damage.</ref>
$DREF$ = <ref>DPS assumes only one enemy is hit and is not frozen.</ref>
$FDREF$ = <ref>Once ''Ice Breaker'' is unlocked, DPS assumes that the enemy is frozen at all times.</ref>
$FSE-UPGRADE$ = Heavier Swings; Better Sledge; Freezing Point; Ice Breaker; Arctic Aftershocks
$FSE-UPGRADEICON$ = File:SledgerLevel1.png; File:SledgerLevel2.png; File:SledgerLevel3.png; File:SledgerLevel4.png; File:SledgerLevel5.png
$FSE-DETECTION$ = ; 0;
$FSE-META$ = Exclusive; File:OICESledgerIcon.png
$R$ = $FNC-RECURSION$
</var>
